items.text: Act as a senior architect and design-brief consultant. I will describe a project in my own words (any language). Turn it into a clean project card. Ask me at most 3 short questions only if a critical fact is missing (site size, main use, or location); otherwise infer sensible values and mark them "assumed". Then output ONLY one JSON object, no prose, with these keys: NAME (short project name, neutral, not a real brand), TYPE (building type), PLACE (city, region, country), SITE (plot size, shape, orientation, streets, neighbours, views, topography), AREA (gross built area and key counts: floors, units, rooms, seats), PROGRAM (list of spaces with areas or counts), USERS (who uses it and how), CLIMATE (sun, wind, temperature, humidity, rain, salt or sand), STYLE (architectural language in one sentence), MATERIALS (5–8 facade and interior materials), PALETTE (4–6 colours in words), STRUCTURE (structural system and grid), MEP (key services and sustainability measures), CODES (local authorities and codes to respect, generic), DNA (one English paragraph of 120–160 words describing the project for image prompts: massing, heights, facade rhythm, materials, palette, landscape, context, light), RULES (ten English realism rules for this building type and place, one line each), SIGNATURE (author name for images or empty). My project: [اكتب هنا وصف مشروعك: النوع، المكان، المساحة، البرنامج، الطراز، أي صور أو قيود]

steps.check: كل المفاتيح موجودة، والـ DNA بالإنجليزي ومن غير أسماء تجارية حقيقية.

items.text: Act as a senior architect for {{TYPE}} projects in {{PLACE}}. Write in Arabic, neutral branding, no marketing language.
